learning_outcomes.text: Students expand their acquired knowledge in vocational didactics. They transfer their knowledge to didactic questions and problems in the design of educational and qualification processes.

Students have an overview of the structures, profiles, and contents of educational and qualification processes in the vocational fields of electrical engineering / automotive engineering / mechanical engineering / information technology and their effects on the design of educational and qualification processes.

Students explain the current state and development trends of didactic guiding principles, curricular frameworks, and their didactic implications. They evaluate options and framework conditions for the use of concepts and methods from a didactic perspective.

Students possess didactic competence; they can plan, implement, and evaluate teaching and training in a target-group-oriented manner, also with regard to heterogeneous learning groups. They evaluate and apply learned strategies and methods for the design of vocational teaching and learning processes.
Students apply procedures and instruments for the analysis of vocational teaching and learning processes as well as vocational competence development and assess their development needs.
Students can professionally discuss subject-didactic tasks and problems with other experts.
Students evaluate the state of their professionalization, also through exchange with fellow students.

syllabus_topics: Basic theories and models of work, cognitive, and learning psychology and their application to the design of vocational teaching and learning processes.
Selection and structuring of suitable learning and teaching contents for vocational education and qualification processes, also considering sustainability aspects.
Subject-specific didactic foundations of action- and competence-oriented learning in initial and continuing vocational training.
Strategies and methods for designing vocational teaching and learning processes, also with regard to heterogeneous learning groups.
Planning and design of vocational education and qualification processes in the vocational fields of electrical engineering / automotive engineering / information technology / mechanical engineering.
Professionalism and competence profiles of teachers in vocational education.
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a term paper with a length of 15 to 25 pages.
